title: Introduction
description: The introduction of the book focusses on the main concepts in computational literary studies and offers a brief history of the field. The accompanying page contains a list of main research and infrastructure projects.

title: 1. Literary historiography and computational text analysis
description: The first chapter presents the main theories of literary historiography and connects them to the most basic approaches in computational text analysis. The accompanying page contains a list of tools and resources for natural language processing.

title: 2. Stylistics and stylometry
description: The second chapter discusses the concept of style in stylistics and stylometry. The accompanying page contains a list of tools and resources in stylometry.

title: 3. Emotions in literature and sentiment analysis
description: The third chapter focusses on emotions in literary studies and in sentiment analysis. The accompanying page contains a list of tools and resources for sentiment analysis.

title: 4. Thematic criticism and topic modeling
description: The fourth chapter explores the connections between thematic criticism and topic modeling. The accompanying page contains a list of tools and resources for topic modeling.

title: 5. Mapping literature
description: The fifth chapter focusses on GIS technology and spatial literary studies. The accompanying page contains a list of tools and resources for mapping.

title: 6. Networking characters
description: The sixth chapter connects character studies and social network analysis. The accompanying page contains a list of tools and resources for network analysis.

title: 7. Intertextuality and text reuse detection
description: The seventh chapter focusses on the issue of intertextuality and its study through computational tools. The accompanying page contains a list of tools and resources for text reuse detection and semantic similarity.

title: 8. Artificial Intelligence and the challenge of interpretation
description: The eight chapter discusses the challenge of interpretation in computational literary studies. The accompanying page contains a list of tools and resources for machine learning and generative artificial intelligence.

title: Conclusion
description: The conclusion reconnects the topics discussed in all chapters through the concept of modeling. The accompanying page contains a list of networking initiatives relevant to Computational Literary Studies.
